department: Department of Mathematics and Computer Science

deadline.value: Funded PhD posts are advertised as separate vacancies, and applications go through the TU/e job site, so there is no single programme deadline.
deadline.quote: If you want to become an employed PhD candidate, you apply for a funded position listed on the TU/e vacancies page

also.quote: Application is always done through the TU/e job site.

gre_subject.value: TU/e's PhD pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Self-funded candidates need a TU/e supervisor's agreement and research proposal; funded projects are chosen by a selection committee.
supervisor.quote: A research proposal and agreement from a TU/e supervisor (if you do not apply through a vacancy)

also.quote: can apply first informally with any assistant, associate or full professor

funding.value: Most PhD candidates at TU/e are employed and paid a salary; the department says some projects are fully funded by a research grant.
funding.quote: Most PhD candidates are employed by TU/e

also.quote: There are projects that are fully funded by a research grant.

entry_route.value: A Dutch master's degree, or a foreign equivalent that TU/e assesses case by case, is expected before starting.
entry_route.quote: A Dutch Master’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in a relevant field

also.quote: Not every foreign preparatory and/or master's program automatically gives you access to a Dutch PhD track

notes: Admission page lists two routes: grant-funded projects (selected by a committee chaired by the principal investigator) and self-funded candidates who apply informally to a professor first. Page also quotes EUR 10,000 tuition for self-funded candidates; this is not an application fee and is not saved.
name: PhD in Industrial and Applied Mathematics
